online.blurb: Join the DeepSpace Workshop on October 22nd for a hands-on session to prepare for GeauxHack. Learn to set up and build with the DeepSpace SDK with direct guidance from their developers. online.title: Modern Web Guidance Workshop
online.blurb: Discover how to enhance AI model efficiency by effectively using agents for debugging. Join this workshop to explore the potential of Chrome Dev Tools for Agents and improve troubleshooting skills. Ideal for developers and tech enthusiasts eager to optimize AI performance.

online.blurb: MACHINE//ALIVE is an event for AI enthusiasts and developers eager to transform machine learning models into user-friendly applications. Participants will discover how to integrate models with real-world apps, implement real-time predictions, and master deployment essentials, moving from laptop prototypes to impactful, usable AI solutions.
